verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a real search query syntax with field qualifiers and negation (e.g. `class:UserError -tag:wip component:"UsersController"`). It supports searching by type, location and metadata, deploy-relative filters like `occurred.after:'last deploy'`, and BadgerQL for filtering and aggregating Insights events, plus a natural-language query builder. missing for 10: explicit evidence of search across multiple projects at once, a documented environment filter, release/version filtering beyond deploy-relative time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
